text: You took the doubling penny over a million bucks. Day twenty, you've got about five grand.
Regret it yet? The deal's one penny that doubles daily for thirty days, no taxes.
Tap the heart if you'd be sweating, 'cause day ten was five bucks.
Day twenty-seven, you're at six hundred seventy-one grand, and still— still losing to the million.
Send this to the friend who'd quit right here.
Day twenty-eight, you finally pass it.
Day thirty, you've got five point three seven million.
So, penny or million? One word.
